title: Verifications
description: verification_requests collection and the admin Verification page are both real and working. SCREEN-MAPPED 2026-08-12 (grounded Explore audit, upgraded from "missing" to "app-mocked"): one real, reachable screen (VerificationScreen) exists off the Profile tab, but it's fully simulated — upload boxes hardcode literal filenames into local state (no file picker, no FirebaseStorage call) and never write to `verification_requests`. No status-tracking (pending/approved/rejected) screen exists; verified status is three local booleans driving badge colors. `VerificationRequestSchema` is defined in BackendSchemas.kt but never instantiated.
